يستجمعا (form X)

# يُسْتَجْمَعَا (yustajmaʕā) /jus.tad͡ʒ.ma.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجْمَعَ (istajmaʕa)
